Undetectable Alignment (B1 Abju): R75' Conceals the target's alignment from divination (save Will negates) for 24 hr
Unseen Servant (B1 Conj): R75' Creates an invisible servant with Strength 2 and a 15' Speed that can perform simple tasks for 20 hr
Veil (B6 Illu): R1200' Makes creatures in a 15' radius appear to be different creatures (save Will negates for targets; save Will upon interaction disbelieves for others) for concentration + 20 hr
Ventriloquism (B1 Illu): Allows speech to originate from a spot within 75' (save Will disbelieves) for 20 min
Whispering Wind (B2 Tran): R20 miles Allows sending a whispered 25-word message or sound to a familiar 10' area
Zone Of Silence (B4 Illu): Prevents sound from escaping a 5' radius for 20 hr
Magic Notes:
Charisma Bard Spell Slot Bonus: Spell level B1, B2
Mass Suggestion: Has increased Suggestion effects
Simple Somatics: Suffers no arcane spell failure risk from wearing light armor
Soothing Performance: R30' Can use a 4 rd Bardic Performance to invoke Mass Cure Serious Wounds effects; also removes fatigued, sickened, and shaken
Suggestion: Can use Suggestion effects on fascinated creatures
